analysis.aggregate: median of paired effects; min/max describe observed pairs, not confidence intervals
analysis.improvement_pct: 100 * (1 - EXP-005 process median / EXP-003 process median)
analysis.speedup: EXP-003 process median / EXP-005 process median
analysis.unit_of_comparison: matched process pair; inner observations are not independent experiments

control_source.method: read-only git show; each file checked against accepted SHA-256

protocol.order: block, then 512/768/1024; adjacent variant pairs; EXP-003 first in odd blocks
